verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that external AI agents can be invited into projects and that ChatGPT and Claude can connect through MCP. That is integration with third-party agents, not a built-in AI assistant inside Basecamp that users can delegate tasks to. Because a built-in assistant is a fair axis for a project-management SaaS, the absence of evidence for one is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: invite co-workers, clients, even AI Agents.
Official Basecamp support for ChatGPT, Claude, and AI agents with full MCP support.
